headline: Israel Diamond Exchange unveils its first new logo and identity in ~50 years, designed by Sporta Digital
why: A new identity needs rollout: brand film, motion logo, signage and social assets. Sporta Digital is not in the map yet.

headline: Wiz co-founder Assaf Rappaport emerging as winning bidder for the McDonald's Israel franchise (run by US HQ since 2024); no official deal yet
why: A new franchisee would likely revisit agency, brand and content suppliers. Still unconfirmed.

headline: Delek Israel 75th-anniversary campaign to Mosh Ben Ari's hit — agency GO, production Oug, director credited as 'Director, AI'
why: The full credit list names the agency, production, post and the client's VP Marketing. AI-directed TV spots are now mainstream here.

headline: Gal Naor's Naor Group buying 70% of Hamat Gader's operator (~NIS 150M); plans ~140 new rooms and an upgrade of baths and spa to international standards
why: A leisure site being repositioned for overnight guests; projects like this often bring a new identity and marketing content. Early stage.

headline: pigment creative house hiring a Video Editor (Tel Aviv) for AI video and full post on commercials, social reels and brand films; posted ~3 days ago
why: A small creative house producing commercials with AI-generated footage; not in the map yet.

why: Out of stealth with fresh funding and 45 people: companies at this stage usually commission a launch video, explainers and a brand system.

headline: Sett (AI UA-creative platform for mobile games; $30M Series B in March) hiring a Creative Technologist for playable ads (Tel Aviv); posted ~5 days ago
why: AI-generated game ads are automating work animators used to do for UA. Sett's tools also guide human production teams.

headline: Amazon in talks to buy Israel's Decart at $7b valuation (WSJ via Globes) — real-time gen-AI video lab, valued ~$4b in May
why: Israel's biggest gen-video lab may scale up fast under Amazon: launch films, demo content and motion/3D hiring tend to follow.

headline: Dudu Ezra Holdings (Shuk Herzl) completes NIS 680M acquisition of Stop Market (11 stores); 23 supermarkets combined, 10 new Shuk Herzl branches planned
why: Both chains keep separate brands, but a merged customer club and 10 new branches mean store-opening and loyalty campaigns.

headline: Discount Capital and Leumi Partners weigh buying ~30% of Adler Chomski at ~NIS 500M valuation (early stage)
why: Possible growth capital for Israel's #2 agency (Bezeq, Strauss, Discount, Mifal HaPais). Early stage; nothing changes yet.

why: A named collection dropping late 2026 usually needs lookbook video, a fashion film and social content beforehand.

why: 3D animation role on a new mobile game; a new game also means trailers, UA creatives and outsourced character animation.

why: A new appliance line entering Israel via a distributor: launch campaigns like this run on social video and product content. No agency is credited in the article.

headline: Base44, the AI app builder recently acquired by Wix, hiring a Motion Designer (Tel Aviv) for styleframes, storyboards and brand motion; posted ~1 week ago
why: A newly acquired product building its own motion identity inside Wix, working with animators, editors and 3D artists.

why: The listing says the lead will brief and review freelance motion artists when projects need more capacity.

headline: Sodastream (PepsiCo) hiring a Global Digital Content Lead (Kfar Saba) for global campaigns and launches, working with agencies and production partners; posted ~1 week ago
why: A global brand run from Israel that briefs external agencies and production partners for platform-native content.

why: The role either makes the films itself or directs external production partners, so outside crews may get work too.

why: Confirms Israir's agency (BBR Saatchi) and shows studio T doing AI work for TV ads.

why: New marketing heads often review suppliers in their first year. Yotvata is a Strauss dairy brand.

why: In-store screen ads are a growing format; someone has to make short, silent, shelf-level video for them.

why: Three years of production for 22 beauty brands now runs through McCann Tel Aviv and Gitam BBDO: beauty CGI, packshots and social video.

why: A fast-growing fashion chain leaning on celebrity exposure; new store openings usually need campaign, lookbook and social video.

why: An AI company buying a performance agency: PPG Digital's creative production may shift toward AI-generated ads.

why: High-volume performance video with vendor management in scope: in-house shoots and post-production.

why: 2D game art role at a Raanana mobile games studio.

why: A bank commissioning episodic branded content rather than spots. Keshet's in-house team handled post and motion design, so broadcasters are competing with studios for this work.

why: AI agents doing growth marketing; worth watching as they move into creative and content work.

why: Senior creative role. Also shows Artlist producing a lot of ad video, which can mean freelance overflow for editors and motion designers.

why: Senior motion role on Wix's in-house team; a growing in-house team can also mean overflow work for studios.

why: Mergers usually bring an agency review or rebrand within months; production may shift between LEAD, No No No No No Yes and KPLN.
